name: opscapsule
description: An isolated workspace for operations tooling and agent runtimes.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:renderer" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main.cjs --external:electron --external:node-pty && esbuild src/main/isolation/sandbox-runner.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/sandbox-runner.mjs --external:@anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime --external:@anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime/* && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron
